summary: Registers the text/troff media subtype for content that mixes text with formatting directives, as used by the troff family of programs. It also describes how to convey the processing steps needed to produce formatted output. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Troff files are plain text sprinkled with formatting commands. This memo gives them an official label so programs know what they are.
